31347.a:
```
lsblk                       # NAME MAJ:MIN RM SIZE RO TYPE MOUNTPOINTS
lsblk -f                    # + FSTYPE, LABEL, UUID, FSAVAIL
lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL,ROTA   # ROTA=1 HDD, 0 SSD
blkid                       # /dev/sdb1: UUID="..." TYPE="ext4"
blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/sdb1
sudo fdisk -l /dev/sdb      # partition jadvali, sector o'lcham, MBR/GPT (Disklabel type)
df -hT                      # mount qilingan FS'lar
cat /proc/partitions
ls -l /dev/disk/by-uuid/ /dev/disk/by-id/
```
Nomlar: `sda` (SATA/SCSI/virtio-scsi), `vda` (virtio), `nvme0n1` (NVMe; partition — `nvme0n1p1`), `xvda` (eski Xen/AWS).
Gotcha: cloud'da (AWS Nitro) EBS `/dev/sdf` deb ulansa ham ichkarida `nvme1n1` ko'rinadi — shuning uchun fstab'da doim UUID.

31348.a:
```
lsblk                                   # yangi disk: /dev/sdb (MOUNTPOINT bo'sh)
sudo parted -s /dev/sdb mklabel gpt
sudo parted -s -a optimal /dev/sdb mkpart data ext4 0% 100%
sudo partprobe /dev/sdb                 # kernel yangi jadvalni o'qisin
sudo mkfs.ext4 -L data /dev/sdb1        # yoki mkfs.xfs
sudo mkdir -p /data
sudo mount /dev/sdb1 /data
sudo blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/sdb1
echo 'UUID=<uuid>  /data  ext4  defaults,noatime,nofail  0 2' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab
sudo umount /data && sudo mount -a     # fstab to'g'riligini reboot'dan OLDIN tekshir
findmnt /data ; df -h /data
```
- **`nofail`** — disk yo'q bo'lsa ham boot to'xtamaydi (aks holda emergency mode).
- fstab ustunlari: qurilma, mount point, FS, opsiyalar, dump (0), fsck tartibi (root=1, boshqalar=2, 0=tekshirmaslik).
- `mount -a` xato bersa — tuzatmasdan reboot qilma.
- Faqat ma'lumot diski bo'lsa partitionsiz ham bo'ladi (`mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdb`), lekin partition — boshqa vositalar uchun aniqroq.

```
sudo growpart /dev/nvme0n1 1           # partition 1 ni oxirigacha (cloud-guest-utils)

sudo resize2fs /dev/nvme0n1p1          # online kengaytirish mumkin
```

```
sudo mkfs.ext4 -i 4096 /dev/sdb1               # har 4KB'ga inode (mayda fayllar uchun)
sudo mkfs.ext4 -N 20000000 /dev/sdb1           # aniq inode soni
```

31353.a:
| Daraja | Min disk | Sig'im (N disk, S hajm) | Chidaydi | Yozish | Qachon |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RAID 0 | 2 | N*S | 0 | eng tez | vaqtinchalik/cache, scratch |
| RAID 1 | 2 | S | N-1 | 1 disk tezligi | OS diski, kichik muhim ma'lumot |
| RAID 5 | 3 | (N-1)*S | 1 | sekin (parity, write penalty 4) | o'qish ko'p arxiv |
| RAID 6 | 4 | (N-2)*S | 2 | yanada sekin (penalty 6) | katta HDD massivlar |
| RAID 10 | 4 | N*S/2 | har mirror juftdan 1 | tez | **DB** |

Senior nuqtalar:
- Katta HDD'larda RAID 5 rebuild soatlab/kunlab davom etadi; shu paytda ikkinchi disk o'lsa yoki URE (o'qib bo'lmaydigan sektor) chiqsa — massiv yo'qoladi. Shuning uchun RAID 6/10.
- **RAID backup emas**: `rm -rf`, ransomware, korrupsiya hamma diskka bir zumda yoziladi.
- Hardware RAID (controller, BBU cache) vs software (mdadm) vs ZFS/Btrfs. Cloud'da odatda RAID kerak emas (EBS o'zi replikatsiyalangan), faqat throughput uchun RAID 0.

```
sudo mdadm --create /dev/md0 --level=1 --raid-devices=2 /dev/sdb /dev/sdc
sudo mdadm --create /dev/md1 --level=10 --raid-devices=4 /dev/sd[d-g]
cat /proc/mdstat                     # [UU] sog'lom, [U_] degraded, resync %
```

L4 load balancer (TCP) vs L7 (HTTP, header/path bo'yicha routing) — interview'da tez-tez so'raladi.

31358.a:
| | TCP | UDP |
|---|---|---|
| Ulanish | 3-way handshake | yo'q |
| Yetkazish | kafolatli, retransmit | kafolat yo'q |
| Tartib | saqlanadi | yo'q |
| Oqim | byte stream | alohida datagramlar |
| Header | 20+ bayt | 8 bayt |
| Nazorat | flow + congestion | yo'q (ilova o'zi) |

Misollar: TCP — HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, SSH, PostgreSQL, Kafka, SMTP. UDP — DNS (katta javobda TCP), NTP, DHCP, syslog, WireGuard, QUIC (HTTP/3 — ishonchlilikni o'zi user space'da qiladi).
Senior: TCP "message" bilmaydi — stream; ilova framing qilishi kerak (length prefix). TCP head-of-line blocking — HTTP/3 ning UDP'ga o'tish sababi.

31359.a:
```
Client                         Server (LISTEN)
 SYN_SENT   ---- SYN ---->      SYN_RECEIVED
 ESTABLISHED <-- SYN+ACK --
            ---- ACK ---->      ESTABLISHED

 FIN_WAIT_1 ---- FIN ---->      CLOSE_WAIT   (ilova close() qilishi kerak)
 FIN_WAIT_2 <--- ACK -----
 TIME_WAIT  <--- FIN -----      LAST_ACK
            ---- ACK ---->      CLOSED
 (2*MSL ~60s) -> CLOSED
```
```
ss -tan | awk 'NR>1{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
```
- **Ko'p CLOSE_WAIT** — **bizning** bug: socket yopilmayapti (Go: `resp.Body.Close()`). FD tugaydi.
- **Ko'p TIME_WAIT** — odatda normal (ko'p qisqa ulanish). Yechim: keep-alive/connection pool; `net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1` (faqat outgoing). `tcp_tw_recycle` — o'chirilgan, NAT'ni buzardi.
- **SYN_RECV ko'p** — SYN flood yoki backlog to'lgan: `tcp_syncookies`, `somaxconn`.
- **SYN_SENT da qolish** — firewall DROP (javob yo'q).

31367.a:
```
Client                                      Server
  ClientHello (TLS 1.3, cipher, SNI=api.x.com, key share) ->
  <- ServerHello (key share) + Certificate + CertVerify + Finished
  Finished ->
  ==== shifrlangan HTTP ====
```
Client tekshiradi:
1. Zanjir: leaf -> intermediate -> trusted root (OS trust store: `/etc/ssl/certs`).
2. Domen: SAN ichida `api.x.com` bormi (CN eskirgan).
3. Muddat: `notBefore`/`notAfter`.
4. Imzo va (ixtiyoriy) revocation (OCSP).

- **SNI** — bitta IP'da ko'p domen, server qaysi sertifikatni berishni biladi.
- TLS 1.3 — 1 RTT, eski zaif cipher'lar yo'q. TLS 1.0/1.1 o'chirilsin.
- mTLS — client ham sertifikat ko'rsatadi (servislar orasida).

31368.a:
```
# serverdagi sertifikat
openssl s_client -connect api.x.com:443 -servername api.x.com </dev/null 2>/dev/null \
  | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName
# zanjirni ko'rish va tekshirish natijasi
openssl s_client -connect api.x.com:443 -servername api.x.com -showcerts </dev/null
#   Verify return code: 0 (ok)  |  21 (unable to verify the first certificate) = intermediate yo'q
# fayl
openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -text
openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -enddate
openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -checkend 1209600 && echo ">14 kun" || echo "TEZ TUGAYDI"
# kalit va sertifikat juftmi (modulus/pubkey hash bir xil bo'lishi kerak)
openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -pubkey | sha256sum
openssl pkey -in key.pem -pubout | sha256sum
# zanjirni lokal tekshirish
openssl verify -CAfile chain.pem cert.pem
# TLS versiya
openssl s_client -connect host:443 -tls1_2
curl -vI https://api.x.com 2>&1 | grep -E "expire|subject|SSL"
```
`-servername` (SNI) qo'yilmasa — server default sertifikatini beradi va noto'g'ri xulosa chiqarasan.

31369.a:
```
# kalit + CSR (SAN bilan)
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout api.key -out api.csr \
  -subj "/CN=api.x.com" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:api.x.com,DNS:www.api.x.com"
openssl req -in api.csr -noout -text
# ECDSA kalit
openssl ecparam -genkey -name prime256v1 -out ec.key
# self-signed (test/ichki)
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 365 -keyout s.key -out s.crt -subj "/CN=localhost"
# konvertatsiya
openssl x509 -in c.der -inform der -out c.pem
openssl pkcs12 -export -in c.pem -inkey k.pem -certfile chain.pem -out c.pfx
openssl pkcs12 -in c.pfx -nodes -out all.pem
```
- `.crt`/`.cer`/`.pem` — kengaytma emas, ichiga qara (`-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----` = PEM).
- `-nodes` — kalit parolsiz (servislar uchun odatiy); private key `chmod 600`, egasi servis user'i.
- Nginx `ssl_certificate` — **fullchain** (leaf + intermediate), aks holda mobil/curl'da *"unable to verify the first certificate"*.

31378.a:
**1. Containment (dalilni saqlab):**
- Cloud: security group'ni faqat sizning IP'ga cheklang, **disk snapshot** oling. Reboot/terminate qilmang (RAM'dagi dalil yo'qoladi).
**2. Tez triage (ishonchli statik binary'lar bilan, tizimdagilar almashtirilgan bo'lishi mumkin):**
```
w ; last -a | head ; lastb | head
ps auxf --sort=-%cpu | head -30          # kripto-mayner? noma'lum nomlar
ls -l /proc/*/exe 2>/dev/null | grep deleted
ss -tupna                                 # noma'lum chiquvchi ulanishlar, listen portlar
crontab -l ; ls -la /etc/cron* /var/spool/cron ; systemctl list-timers
systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled
cat ~/.ssh/authorized_keys /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
find / -xdev -mtime -2 -type f -path '/etc/*' -o -path '/usr/bin/*' 2>/dev/null | head
find / -xdev -perm -4000 -type f -newer /etc/hostname 2>/dev/null   # yangi SUID
journalctl -u ssh --since "-3d" | grep Accepted
rpm -Va / debsums -c                      # paket fayllari o'zgarganmi
```
**3. Eradication:** serverni **noldan qayta qur** (IaC'dan), tozalashga urinma. Barcha secret'larni almashtir: SSH kalitlar, DB parollar, API token'lar, cloud kalitlar.
**4. Root cause:** kirish yo'li — eski paket CVE, ochiq parolli SSH, sizib chiqqan kalit, ochiq Redis/Docker API.
**5. Postmortem + qonuniy talablar** (PII bo'lsa xabar berish majburiyati).

31380.a:
| Resurs | Utilization | Saturation | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| CPU | `1 - idle` | load/nproc, run queue, PSI cpu | — |
| RAM | MemAvailable | swap in/out, PSI memory, OOM | OOM kill |
| Disk IO | %util | await, aqu-sz, PSI io | I/O errors (dmesg) |
| FS | df %, inode % | — | ro remount |
| Network | throughput | drops, retrans, conntrack | NIC errors |

Alert misollari (PromQL):
```
# disk 4 soatda to'ladi
predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs"}[6h], 4*3600) < 0
# RAM
node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes < 0.1
# host yo'q
up{job="node"} == 0
# vaqt siljishi
abs(node_timex_offset_seconds) > 0.05
# RAID degraded
node_md_disks{state="failed"} > 0
```
Qo'shimcha: systemd unit failed (`node_systemd_unit_state`), sertifikat muddati (blackbox), backup yoshi.
Qoida: har alert'da runbook havolasi; tunda uyg'otadigan alert = foydalanuvchiga ta'sir yoki tez orada ta'sir.

31381.a:
| # | Qatlam | Vazifa | PDU | Manzil | Qurilma / misol |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | Application | ilova protokoli | data | URL, domen | HTTP, DNS, SMTP, SSH; L7 LB, WAF, API gateway |
| 6 | Presentation | format, shifrlash, siqish | data | — | TLS, JSON/Protobuf, gzip, UTF-8 |
| 5 | Session | sessiyani ochish/ushlash/yopish | data | — | RPC sessiya, TLS session resumption |
| 4 | Transport | end-to-end, portlar, ishonchlilik | segment (TCP) / datagram (UDP) | port | TCP, UDP; L4 LB, NAT (port) |
| 3 | Network | marshrutlash tarmoqlar orasida | packet | IP | router, L3 switch, firewall, ICMP |
| 2 | Data link | bitta segment ichida yetkazish | frame | MAC | switch, bridge, VLAN, ARP, Wi-Fi |
| 1 | Physical | bitlarni signalga | bit | — | kabel, optika, hub, repeater, NIC PHY |

Eslab qolish (1 dan 7 ga): **"Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away"** — Physical, Data link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.

Muhim nuance: OSI — o'quv/nazariy model; real internet TCP/IP (4 qatlam) bo'yicha ishlaydi. 5-6-7 amalda bitta "Application" ga birlashadi. TLS qaysi qatlamda? — aniq bitta emas (4 bilan 7 orasida); interview'da shuni aytish kuchli javob.

31382.a:
```
App      [ HTTP: GET /api ]
L4       [ TCP: sport 51544 dport 443 seq ack | HTTP ]                 = segment
L3       [ IP: src 10.0.1.10 dst 93.184.216.34 TTL | TCP | HTTP ]       = packet
L2       [ ETH: src MAC dst MAC(gateway!) | IP | TCP | HTTP | FCS ]     = frame
L1       0101010110...                                                  = bits
```
Har hop'da (router):
- L2 header olib tashlanadi va yangi MAC'lar bilan qayta yoziladi (dst MAC = keyingi hop).
- IP src/dst o'zgarmaydi (NAT bundan mustasno), `TTL` 1 ga kamayadi (0 bo'lsa ICMP Time Exceeded — `traceroute` shunga asoslangan).

Overhead va MTU: Ethernet MTU 1500 = IP header 20 + TCP header 20 + **MSS 1460** bayt ma'lumot. VXLAN/VPN qo'shimcha header qo'shadi -> ichki MTU 1450 va hokazo (PMTU muammolari shu yerdan).
`tcpdump -e -nn` — L2 (MAC) header'larni ham ko'rsatadi.

31383.a:
1. **URL parse, kesh**: HSTS -> https majburiy.
2. **DNS (L7 over UDP/TCP 53)**: brauzer kesh -> OS (`/etc/hosts`, systemd-resolved) -> resolver -> root -> .com -> authoritative. Test: `dig example.com`.
3. **Route (L3)**: dst IP lokal tarmoqda emas -> default gateway. `ip route get <ip>`.
4. **ARP (L2)**: gateway MAC'ini topish. `ip neigh`.
5. **TCP (L4)**: SYN -> SYN/ACK -> ACK, port 443. `nc -zv example.com 443`.
6. **TLS (L5-L6)**: ClientHello + SNI, sertifikat zanjiri, key exchange. `openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -servername example.com`.
7. **HTTP (L7)**: `GET / HTTP/2`, Host, cookie. CDN/LB (L4 yoki L7) -> reverse proxy (nginx) -> app -> DB/cache.
8. **Javob**: status, header'lar (cache-control), body; brauzer HTML parse, qo'shimcha resurslar (yana 2-7, lekin ulanish qayta ishlatiladi — keep-alive/HTTP2 multiplexing).

Bitta buyruqda vaqt bo'yicha:
```
curl -o /dev/null -s -w "dns %{time_namelookup}\ntcp %{time_connect}\ntls %{time_appconnect}\nttfb %{time_starttransfer}\ntotal %{time_total}\n" https://example.com
```

31384.a:
| | L4 (Transport) | L7 (Application) |
|---|---|---|
| Ko'radi | src/dst IP, port, protokol | URL, Host, header, cookie, method |
| Routing | ulanish bo'yicha | so'rov bo'yicha (`/api` -> A, `/img` -> B) |
| TLS | passthrough (backend yechadi) | termination (LB yechadi, sertifikat LB'da) |
| Client IP | saqlanadi (yoki PROXY protocol) | `X-Forwarded-For` header |
| Tezlik | juda yuqori, past latency | ko'proq CPU |
| Protokol | istalgan TCP/UDP (DB, gRPC, MQTT) | HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket |
| Misol | AWS NLB, HAProxy `mode tcp`, LVS/IPVS, kube-proxy | AWS ALB, nginx, Envoy, Traefik, HAProxy `mode http` |

Senior nuqtalar:
- gRPC/HTTP2 + L4 LB = bitta uzun ulanish bitta backend'ga yopishib qoladi (yuk notekis) — L7 kerak.
- L7 da TLS terminatsiya qilinsa ichki trafik shifrlanmagan bo'lishi mumkin — mTLS / re-encrypt.
- Health check: L4 — port ochiqmi; L7 — `/health` 200 qaytaradimi (ancha ishonchli).

31385.a:
| Qatlam | Savol | Buyruq | Buzilish belgisi |
|---|---|---|---|
| L1 Physical | link bormi? | `ethtool eth0`, `ip link` | `Link detected: no`, `NO-CARRIER`, CRC errors |
| L2 Data link | gateway MAC ma'lummi? | `ip neigh`, `arping`, `bridge vlan` | `FAILED`/`INCOMPLETE`, IP konflikt |
| L3 Network | IP, route bormi? | `ip a`, `ip route get X`, `ping`, `mtr` | `Network is unreachable`, `No route to host`, loss |
| L4 Transport | port ochiqmi? | `ss -tlnp`, `nc -zv`, `tcpdump 'tcp[tcpflags]&tcp-syn!=0'` | `Connection refused` (RST), timeout (DROP) |
| L5-6 TLS | handshake o'tadimi? | `openssl s_client -servername` | `certificate verify failed`, `handshake failure`, SNI xato |
| L7 Application | DNS va HTTP to'g'rimi? | `dig`, `getent hosts`, `curl -v` | `NXDOMAIN`, 4xx/5xx, sekin TTFB |

Xato xabarlarini o'qish:
- *Connection refused* — host tirik, port yopiq (L4, ilova ishlamaydi yoki 127.0.0.1 da).
- *Connection timed out* — paket qaytmayapti: firewall DROP, SG, route (L3/L4).
- *No route to host* — route yo'q yoki ICMP host-unreachable / REJECT.
- *Name or service not known* — DNS (L7).

Interview javobi qolipi: "Pastdan yuqoriga — avval link va IP, keyin route, port, TLS, oxirida ilova. Har qatlamni bitta buyruq bilan tasdiqlayman, taxmin qilmayman."
